description: PAID $0.001 USDC. DeFi protocol TVL in USD from our own on-chain reads, per-chain TVL, category and chains (1d/7d change once history builds). Examples: q=aave, q=uniswap. Refreshed about every 30 min. Returns JSON protocol TVL in USD, per-chain TVL, category, and chains.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

q.description: DeFi protocol slug or name. Format: a lowercase slug or a name. Example: aave. Another example already in the tool text: aave-v3. Required.

name: lookup_protocol
title: DeFi protocol TVL lookup ($0.001)
